briefing: This is {PATRON}. I run the docks at {HERE}, and a Krait has been picking off ships on our lane.
Find it, burn it, and the fee is yours the day you dock here again.
dossier.lead: Word comes in that {PATRON} at {WORLD} wants a word with you.

hunt.arrive: Destroy the Krait last seen at {TARGET} and claim {PAY}
hunt.success: The Krait burns, and {PAY} is now yours
hunt.fail: The Krait slipped away, and {PAY} stays on the board

dossier.news: {PATRON} at {WORLD} still wants the lane Krait destroyed.

rumour.far: Traders say {PATRON} at {WORLD} is paying well for a dead Krait.
rumour.near: {PATRON} sends word from {WORLD} that the Krait bounty still stands.

story.opening: She signed on to hunt a Krait at {WORLD} on day {DAY}.

closing.complete: By day {DAY}, the Krait bounty out of {WORLD} was closed for good.
closing.fail: By day {DAY}, the Krait bounty out of {WORLD} had gone unpaid.

hunt.targetDestroyed: At {WORLD} on day {DAY}, the Krait was destroyed and the bounty paid.
hunt.targetEscaped: At {WORLD} on day {DAY}, the Krait jumped clear and the trail went cold.
hunt.failed: By day {DAY}, the hunt near {WORLD} had run past its deadline.

dossier.title: Krait on the Lane
